sub_question: Identify all legislators whose first term started on or after January 1, 1917 and on or before December 31, 1999.
sub_sql:
SELECT l.full_name
FROM legislators l
JOIN (
    SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) AS first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
) ft ON l.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
WHERE ft.first_term_start >= '1917-01-01'
  AND ft.first_term_start <= '1999-12-31';

sub_question: Record the start date of each identified legislator.
sub_sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT l.full_name, ft.first_term_start
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN (
        SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) AS first_term_start
        FROM legislators_terms
        GROUP BY id_bioguide
    ) ft ON l.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
    WHERE ft.first_term_start >= '1917-01-01'
      AND ft.first_term_start <= '1999-12-31'
)
SELECT full_name, first_term_start
FROM base;

sub_question: For each identified legislator, create twenty reference dates corresponding to December 31 of each year from the first year after the start date through the twentieth year after the start date.
sub_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE base AS (
    SELECT l.id_bioguide,
           l.full_name,
           ft.first_term_start
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN (
        SELECT id_bioguide,
               MIN(term_start) AS first_term_start
        FROM legislators_terms
        GROUP BY id_bioguide
    ) ft ON l.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
    WHERE ft.first_term_start >= '1917-01-01'
      AND ft.first_term_start <= '1999-12-31'
),
nums AS (
    SELECT 1 AS n
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n + 1 FROM nums WHERE n < 20
)
SELECT b.id_bioguide,
       b.full_name,
       printf('%04d-12-31', CAST(strftime('%Y', b.first_term_start) AS INTEGER) + n) AS reference_date
FROM base b
JOIN nums ON 1 = 1
ORDER BY b.id_bioguide, n;
